description: Compact canonical stage windows derived from copper labels. stage_num is priority-resolved as continuous, then confirmed, then provisional.
sql: SELECT CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_uid, fleet_name, pad_name, name AS well_name, id AS well_id, api_num, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_num, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_start_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_end_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS provisional_start_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS provisional_end_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS confirmed_start_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS confirmed_end_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS continuous_start_ts, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS continuous_end_ts, CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS is_closed, CAST(NULL AS BOOLEAN) AS has_mid, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS sample_count, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS avg_rate_slurry, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS max_rate_slurry, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS avg_press_mainline, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS max_press_mainline, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stage_status, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS source_stage_column, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS algorithm_version, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS source_mode, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS processed_at FROM datastore:merged_fleet_stream_customer_full_v2 WHERE 1 = 0
